frontmatter.name: finish-ticket
frontmatter.description: Verify completed ticket work against its acceptance criteria, run the required Go and Graphify checks, review the diff, and prepare a commit and pull request handoff. Use when implementation is ready for review; do not use to start unrelated work or merge a pull request.

frontmatter.name: start-ticket
frontmatter.description: Start a ticket from plan.md or GitHub safely by validating its scope and dependencies, inspecting relevant repository context, and creating a correctly named local branch. Use when beginning a new implementation ticket; do not use to finish, push, or merge work.
